title: Xdrip + Android Wear (Sony Smartwatch 3)
symptom: The user reports that in the latest version of xDrip they have, Android Wear is not supported, and they want to use it with a Sony Smartwatch 3.
fix: The maintainer suggests checking the 'Android Wear Integration' in the 'Smart Watch Features' settings.
evidence_quote: You should find the "Android Wear Integration" in the "Smart Watch Features" settings.
